_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the canonical/deployed model. Tooling (run_val.py, auto_label.py, backfill_per_class.py) and the runtime hot-swap presets resolve from here, so 'which model are we running?' lives in exactly ONE place. Paths are relative to the repo root. Update this file when a new training run is promoted to deployed. NOTE: the .pt of the deployed run lives on the DGX (the training host); only the .onnx is mirrored to the Mac for runtime inference, so .pt-based tools (val/label) run where the .pt exists.
